// Quoting and word splitting.
$ echo hello   world
hello world
$ echo "a  b" 'c $HOME' $HOME
a  b c $HOME /root
$ echo "double \"quoted\" \$HOME" 'single \n'
double "quoted" $HOME single \n
$ echo a\ b\\c
a b\c
$ echo ''

$ echo "" | wc -c
1
$ echo 'unterminated
-bash: syntax error near unexpected token `newline'
[exit 2]

// Variables.
$ X=5; echo "x=$X" ${X} ${Y:-default} ${#HOME}
x=5 5 default 5
$ X=1 env | grep '^X='
X=1
$ echo $X
5
$ unset X; echo "[$X]"
[]
$ echo $SHELL $USER $HOME $PWD
/bin/bash root /root /root
$ echo $UID $HOSTNAME
0 ip-10-0-2-15
$ A="one two"; echo $A
one two
$ false; echo $?
1
$ nosuchcommand; echo $?
nosuchcommand: command not found
127

// Command substitution and arithmetic.
$ echo $(echo nested) `echo tick`
nested tick
$ echo "$(echo a; echo b)"
a
b
$ echo $(echo a; echo b)
a b
$ echo $((2 + 3 * 4)) $((10 / 3)) $((7 % 4))
14 3 3
$ echo ${HOME}/x ~ ~/sub ~root
/root/x /root /root/sub /root

// Globbing.
$ echo /etc/host*
/etc/hostname /etc/hosts
$ echo /etc/nothing*
/etc/nothing*
$ echo '/etc/host*' "/etc/host*"
/etc/host* /etc/host*
$ cd /etc && echo *.conf
resolv.conf
$ ls -d /usr/*bin
/usr/bin  /usr/sbin
